faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your offline application for the PGIMER Project Nurse-II position is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Second Class or equivalent CGPA with a 3-year general nursing & Midwife (GNM) course. A B.Sc. Nursing (4 Years) is also acceptable. Experience in Pediatrics is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse-II post is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for OBC (3 years) and SC/ST (5 years) candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20000 per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Nurse-II position announced under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the PGIMER Project Nurse-II recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a written test or an interview, depending on the number of applications received. Candidates will be notified about the specific selection method.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of PGIMER, which is www.pgimer.edu.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment. Please refer to the detailed advertisement for confirmation.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is MPS/VIRO/UC/26/25.
